flurry.motion_shape: Slow curved load, held preparation, accelerating cubic downstroke, abrupt planted impact, delayed body compression and damped recovery. Uniform phase speed is forbidden.
flurry.damage_policy: Server ground footprint at each contacting palm; player pawns once per beat, including the double-palm finisher. Existing melee damage and defenses retained.

source_note: Original V28 full-body flurry and pronounced bite on the retained V25 rig. Stable upper-limb frames retained, paired brace steps support increased torso movement. No extracted game animation.
